zh.title: 美國破產法院批准Google以1,000萬美元收購精神航空資料
zh.summary: Google加強隱私保障後，美國破產法官批准這宗涉及精神航空內部營運與員工資料的交易。
body: 路透報導，美國紐約一名聯邦破產法官於11月17日開庭時，批准Google以1,000萬美元收購已停航的精神航空內部商業資料。
Google於8月競標取得收購資格，並表示打算將資料用於產品開發與人工智慧訓練。工會和美國國會議員提出隱私疑慮後，Google同意增加保護措施，法院隨後批准交易。

en.title: U.S. bankruptcy judge approves Google’s $10 million Spirit Airlines data purchase
en.summary: A bankruptcy judge cleared the sale of internal Spirit Airlines data after Google agreed to additional privacy safeguards.
body: A federal bankruptcy judge in New York approved Google’s $10 million purchase of internal records from defunct Spirit Airlines at a November 17 hearing, Reuters reported.

Google won an auction for the data in August and says it plans to use it for product development and AI training. The court approved the sale after Google agreed to additional privacy protections in response to concerns raised by unions and U.S. lawmakers.

facts.claim: U.S. Bankruptcy Judge Sean Lane approved Google’s $10 million acquisition of internal Spirit Airlines business data at a November 17 hearing.
The approval followed Google’s agreement to strengthen privacy protections after objections from unions and lawmakers.
Google won the August auction and says it plans to use the data for product development and AI training.
The revised proposed sale order was filed in the bankruptcy case, with a November 17 hearing scheduled.
